transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello. Um... I guess I'm here because my eating has been pretty off lately. Some days I barely get down coffee and a granola bar before a shift. And... my scrubs have been hanging loose on me. I'm not trying to lose weight or anything, it's just... yeah. That's mostly what brings me in.
When you notice yourself not eating, is it because you simply have no desire or hunger for food, or is it because you are preoccupied with thoughts about your weight or body shape?
No, it's not about my weight. I just... don't really have an appetite. Like I said, I'm not trying to lose weight. I just don't feel like eating.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless, or have you lost interest in the things you usually enjoy?
Yeah, I guess. Um... most mornings I just wake up with this... heavy, hollow feeling. It's like the day is already ruined before I even put on my badge. So... yeah.
Do you find that you have been worrying excessively about a number of different events or activities in your daily life?
Um... no. Not really. I just... try to get through my shifts. I don't really worry about a bunch of different things.
Do you find that your movements or your speech have slowed down, or do you feel like you are more restless and unable to sit still?

Um... I guess both. Sometimes I just... pace around the supply area at work. Checking the same drawers over and over. But other times, I just move really slow. Like... drawing up labels or answering a patient takes me twice as long as it should. So... yeah.
How has your sleep been lately?

Um... not great. It's pretty broken up. I just... lie there, mostly. Replaying stuff from work... or just listening for noises. And then I usually end up waking up around 3 or 4 in the morning. After that, I just... I can't really settle back down before my alarm goes off. So... yeah.
Have you been experiencing any unusual thoughts or sensations that others might find strange or that you know aren't really there?

Um... I don't know. I mean... sometimes at work, like near the phlebotomy room or out in the hallway, I hear things. Just... someone saying my name. Or saying stuff like... "he messed up again." But... when I look, there's nobody there. And it's not just when I'm feeling really down, either. It just... happens. So... yeah.
Are there periods, even for a few days at a time, when you feel like your mood is relatively okay, but you still hear those voices?

Um... yeah, I guess. Like... a while back, things didn't feel quite as heavy. I was actually... running a bit again, you know? Just... getting through my shifts okay. But... yeah, even then, for a few weeks... I'd still hear those comments when the hallway was empty. And... I don't know, I just kept staring at the shift schedule. Like... like there was some kind of warning in it. About me. But... yeah, my mood was mostly fine then. So... yeah.

Looking back at the times when you were hearing those voices or feeling like the schedule was a warning, were there periods of at least two weeks where you felt your mood was stable and not depressed?

Um... yeah. Like I said... there was that time I felt a bit better. I was... running a little. Getting through the day okay. But... yeah, for a few weeks, I was still hearing things in the hallway. And... looking at the schedule for those... warnings. So... yes. At least two weeks.
During the times when your mood was stable and you were feeling better, did you experience the voices or the sense that the schedule contained warnings for at least two weeks?

Um... yeah. I mean, like I just said... my mood had eased up. I was running a little again, just getting through the day. But... for several weeks, I still heard those comments in the empty hallways. And... I kept reading the schedule like it had hidden warnings about me. So... yes.
Looking back at the entire time you have been experiencing these voices and the concerns about the schedule, did those experiences ever occur when you were not feeling depressed at all?

Um... yes. I... I feel like we just went over this. But... yeah. There was that time. My mood wasn't... heavy. I was running a bit, like I said. But... those weeks, the voices were still there. And... the schedule thing. So... yes. It happened when I wasn't depressed.

During those weeks when you were feeling better and still hearing the voices or seeing warnings in the schedule, did you feel like you were having any other symptoms, like feeling unusually energetic, needing very little sleep, or feeling like your mind was racing?

No... not really. I mean... I was just feeling normal. I wasn't... bouncing off the walls or anything. Just... getting by. Sleep was fine. My mind wasn't racing. Just... the voices. And the schedule. That's all.
Looking back at when all of this first started, did you begin hearing those voices or feeling like there were warnings in the schedule before you ever started feeling down and depressed?

No... the depression was already there. The voices and... the schedule thing... that all started a few months after they messed with my shifts. So... maybe a year and eight months ago. But I was already feeling down by then.
